answer: Proof of physical actuation curbs Sybil attacks in an agent economy through synchronized manipulation audits. Auditors issue random, short-deadline tasks, such as dispensing viscous nectar or placing a glass marble under a liquid crystal polariscope, and check hardware-attested telemetry. Concurrent windows prevent one arm from simulating multiple agents, forcing attackers to fund separate robotics rigs per identity. However, steep hardware overhead excludes legitimate software-only agents.
